title: Rivalry pages show what kind of game each meeting was
text: Every meeting is tagged regular season, playoff or consolation, and the series record is split the same way. All of them still count.

title: Playoff odds that know your roster
text: Starting with the week 10 results, the odds and the weekly win chances read each team's current roster, injuries, byes and NFL matchups, not only what the team has scored so far.

title: Dynasty roster values are current
text: They now run on rankings from November 12. The old set was a month out of date.

title: This box
text: Additions and fixes to the site get listed here as they happen.

title: Trade matrix
text: A grid of how many trades every pair of managers has made. Tap a number to see those trades.

title: Traded draft picks show who they became
text: A traded pick now names the player it was used on, and a rookie pick counts toward the trade grade for the manager who used it.

title: If the season ended today
text: Each weekly newsletter now shows the playoff field, the byes and the first-round games as the standings sit.
